manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Verify that a disclosure-page 様式第2号 PDF with an 更新確認申請書 appendix remains review-bound when the only visible dates are page-update or officer-term dates.
steps: Use the Saitama official-index URL registered as the school's prefecture_aggregator disclosure site.
Open the school information/disclosure page and inspect the anchor labeled 確認申請 様式第２号（令和7年6月26日更新）.
Extract the PDF text and confirm it is a 様式第2号 target-form bundle for 中央情報専門学校 with a 更新確認申請書 appendix.
Confirm the PDF body contains no 令和8/2026年度 target-year evidence and that 2025 appears only in officer-term contexts.
Classify it as needs_operator_review because page update dates and officer terms do not prove FY2026.

reusable_rules: Keep 様式第2号 anchors and 更新確認申請書 appendices as high-value candidates.
Do not accept a target-form PDF as current FY when the only dates are page update dates, officer terms, or generic prior-year dates.
Preserve the direct PDF URL for operator review when target-form evidence exists but target-year evidence is missing.
anti_patterns: Do not treat anchor text such as 令和7年6月26日更新 as target fiscal-year evidence.
Do not treat 2025 officer-term dates inside the PDF as target application-year evidence.
Do not discard the PDF as non-target just because strict target-year evidence is missing.

evidence.notes: Windows v333 Saitama 50-site replay records this candidate as reason=target_fiscal_year_not_detected, pdf_type=target. Manual PyMuPDF extraction found readable 様式第2号 text and a 更新確認申請書 appendix, but no 令和8, 令和８, 2026, or 2026年度 target-year evidence.
